> Clean by construction: a heading that is title-cased because it names a

## The Small Print Nobody Reads

Our terms page changed in three places this month. The retention window for
uploaded files moved from ninety days to thirty, the arbitration clause was
removed, and the support commitment now names business hours in the customer's
own timezone rather than ours.

We emailed every account owner a diff rather than a summary. Two replied with
questions and both were about retention.
